items.title: 53279_Lee Young Oral History Interview
items.q: another movie that I did at Paramount Studios with Louis Armstrong and Mae West

ctx.x: That was a movie that Lena was in, and there was a big scene in there, you know. The big thing in town at the time with all the studios running were extras, you know. Whites and blacks got a lot of work from being extras. So they used to always have to go out to the casting thing.

Oh, another movie that I did at Paramount Studios with Louis Armstrong and Mae West. Now I don't know the name of that movie, but that was the one where I wrote the drum parts for it because they wanted it to be a march, but they wanted to have the feel of 4/4 type of thing. And I'll never forget -- we were doing these things; we were shooting like, we started at 11 o'clock at night. It had to be a night scene

and we'd go until morning. And Pops would sit around and tell stories and we would jam right there in the street; it was a street scene over there in Paramount. But it was a Mae West picture, but I don't know the name of it.
